title: Kestrel Dispensing Standard: Renewal Bridge on Lost-or-Stolen Prescriptions Replacements
content:
A lost-or-stolen replacement of a Kestrel Prescriptions record that is near the end of its refills carries the theft replacement renewal bridge.

## Clause

The theft replacement renewal bridge looks at the refills left on the prescription, being the refills the prescriber authorized less the refills used by its refills plus the refills restored by returns to stock:

| Refills left | Days added |
|---|---|
| exactly 1 | 5 |
| exactly 2 | 2 |
| any other number | nothing |

These days are added to the lost days remaining after any restraint, before the days covered by a corrected remake are taken off; the theft replacement days supply is never below zero and is taken down to whole days.

## Readings (hypothetical ledgers)

| Refills authorized | Used by refills | Restored by returns to stock | Refills left | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 4 | 0 | 1 | 5 |
| 5 | 4 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | nothing |
| 5 | 2 | 0 | 3 | nothing |
